traceability.notes: The 010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT story is fully implemented. The codebase introduces a dedicated @supports parsing and validation path (valid-annotation-format + valid-implements-utils), deep requirement validation per story file for @supports (valid-req-reference), and updates the require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation flows so that @supports satisfies both story and requirement presence checks without breaking existing @story/@req behavior. Mixed usage of both styles in the same comment is explicitly supported and tested. Error messages for missing requirements clearly include both the requirement ID and the story path. Requirement IDs are scoped per story file via a per-file cache, allowing the same ID to exist in multiple stories. Multiple Jest test files are explicitly tied to this story via @story/@req tags and exercise single-story, multi-story, and mixed-annotation scenarios, all of which pass. While some process items in the story’s Definition of Done (e.g., external integration against dry-aged-deps) are unchecked, all functional acceptance criteria and technical requirements in the story are satisfied and verified by the automated test suite.
